name: Valor Equity Partners
monetization: Growth-stage private equity firm (Chicago); long-time backer of Musk companies (Tesla, SpaceX, xAI); earns management fees and carry, increasingly on AI-infrastructure structured vehicles.
description_md: Valor Equity Partners is the anchor equity investor in the ~$20B xAI GPU SPV (Oct 2025) that buys NVIDIA GPUs and leases them to xAI for the Colossus 2 campus in Memphis — the marquee example of moving GPU capex off an AI lab's balance sheet. Valor also participated in xAI's $20B Series E (Jan 2026).

observations.notes: Total equity tranche of the ~$20B SPV; Valor's own commitment is undisclosed.
